title: EpixChain v0.7.1 Upgrade: Transaction Handling Improvements
summary:
What changes:
- Transaction signature verification now honours the node's signature-verification mode, removing redundant work on replayed transactions
- The mempool rejects EVM transactions priced below the current base fee at admission, instead of accepting them and failing later
- The EVM state database snapshots locked (vesting) balances when an account is loaded, and hardens how balance and event amounts are handled
- Balance subtraction now fails loudly on underflow rather than wrapping around
- IBC acknowledgement validation in the ERC20 middleware is aligned with ibc-go
